---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new tool, tweak or improvement
title: '[Feature]: '
labels: 'enhancement'
---

### What problem does it solve?
What you are trying to do and why the current app does not cover it.

### Proposed solution
How you imagine it working (screen, option, tweak...). For a Windows tweak, include the registry key, service or
command and a source that documents it.

### Alternatives
Other tools or approaches you considered.
